access_trace.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  a.STREET_NUMBER,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON r.BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE r.DEPT_CODE IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  FROM SUBJECT_ENROLLABLE
  WHERE OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '6'
)
